SELECT CAST(v AS DECIMAL(10,2)) % n AS r FROM VALUES ('7',CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(10,2))) t(v,n)
SELECT CAST('bad' AS DECIMAL(10,2)) % n AS r FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN id%2=0 THEN CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2)) ELSE 2 END AS n FROM range(1)) t
